newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen plans to raise steel prices.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen plans to raise steel prices.

text.p: Thyssen Stahl AG said on Monday it would raise prices for semi-finished steel products for drop forging by at least five percent, depending on quality, effective July 1.

"In view of the (plant) utilisation situation among German and foreign drop forges and our competitors, we are sure that this price rise can be implemented in the market," Thyssen said in a statement.
The steel unit of Thyssen AG already announced plans to raise prices for flat steel products as of July 1 in response to strong demand.
